title: Home - Institutional Portal
excerpt: Official Web Portal of St. Philomena's College (Autonomous), Mysuru.
content: Welcome to St. Philomena's College (Autonomous), Mysuru. Established in 1946 by His Excellency Rt. Rev. Dr. Rene Feuga, affiliated to the University of Mysore, and re-accredited with NAAC A+ grade.
seoTitle: St. Philomena's College (Autonomous), Mysuru
seoDescription: Premier Autonomous College offering UG, PG, and Doctoral research in Mysuru.

title: About Us - History & Heritage
excerpt: Historic Catholic educational institution established in 1946 by Rev. Dr. Rene Feuga.
content: Founded on October 9, 1946, St. Philomena’s College is a premier autonomous educational institution managed by the Mysore Diocesan Educational Society (MDES). Rooted in Catholic educational traditions, the college fosters value-based education for students from across 28 Indian states and 32 foreign countries.
seoTitle: About Us | St. Philomena's College
seoDescription: Learn about the heritage, leadership, and visionary educational foundation of St. Philomena's College.

title: Vision, Mission & History
excerpt: Vision, mission, and historic milestones since 1946.
content: The college is guided by the visionary zeal of providing value-based education to everyone irrespective of religion, caste, creed or sex. Our mission is to holistically transform young men and women into intellectually curious, emotionally resilient, and socially responsible individuals.
seoTitle: History, Vision & Mission | St. Philomena's College
seoDescription: Vision and Mission statements and historical foundation of St. Philomena's College.

title: Vision and Mission
excerpt: Academic and spiritual vision and mission statement of St. Philomena's College.
content: Vision: To provide value-based higher education to everyone, fostering character formation and academic enlightenment.\n\nMission: To holistically transform young individuals through disciplined inquiry, compassionate service, and unwavering integrity.
seoTitle: Vision and Mission | St. Philomena's College
seoDescription: Institutional vision and mission.

title: Coat of Arms & Crest
excerpt: Historic crest, Latin motto "Caritas in Scientia", and heraldic symbolism.
content: The college received its motto "Caritas in Scientia" (Knowledge Through Love) directly from the Holy Father before its foundation on October 9, 1946. The crest features Saint Philomena, the anchor of hope, arrows of fortitude, lilies of purity, palm branch of martyrdom, and the scourge of unwavering courage.
seoTitle: Coat of Arms | St. Philomena's College
seoDescription: Coat of arms and heraldic motto.

title: Former Bishops of Mysore
excerpt: Patrons and Bishops of the Diocese of Mysore who guided the institution.
content: St. Philomena's College honors the lineage of Catholic Bishops of Mysore who served as patrons and presidents of MDES, including founding patron Rt. Rev. Dr. Rene Feuga, Bishop Mathias Fernandes, Bishop Joseph Roy, and Bishop Thomas Antony Vazhapilly.
seoTitle: Former Bishops | St. Philomena's College
seoDescription: Patrons and Catholic Bishops of Mysore Diocese.

title: Former Principals
